# ISummerVestingWallet
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerVestingWallet.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerVestingWallet

Interface for SummerVestingWallet, a vesting wallet with time-based and performance-based
release schedules for Summer team members, investors and ex-team members.

Interface for SummerVestingWallet, an extension of OpenZeppelin's VestingWallet with custom vesting schedules
and separate admin role.
Supports two types of vesting: Team vesting and Investor/Ex-Team vesting, both with a 6-month cliff.
Vesting Schedules:
1. Team Vesting:
- Time-based: Monthly releases over 2 years, starting after the 6-month cliff.
- Performance-based: arbitrary amount of additional milestone-based releases, triggered by the guardian.
2. Investor/Ex-Team Vesting:
- Time-based only: Monthly releases over 2 years, starting after the 6-month cliff.
The guardian role can mark performance goals as reached for team vesting and recall unvested
performance-based tokens if necessary.

### addNewGoal

MUTATIVE FUNCTIONS           ///

Adds a new performance-based vesting goal to the contract

This function can only be called by an address with the GUARDIAN_ROLE

The new goal is appended to the existing goalAmounts array

A corresponding false value is added to the goalsReached array

This function allows for dynamic expansion of performance-based vesting goals

The caller must transfer the goalAmount of tokens to this contract after calling this function


```solidity
function addNewGoal(uint256 goalAmount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`goalAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens associated with the new performance goal|


### markGoalReached

Marks a specific performance goal as reached

This function can only be called by an address with the GUARDIAN_ROLE


```solidity
function markGoalReached(uint256 goalNumber) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`goalNumber`|`uint256`|The number of the goal to mark as reached (1-indexed)|


### recallUnvestedTokens

Recalls unvested performance-based tokens

This function can only be called by an address with the GUARDIAN_ROLE

It's only applicable for TeamVesting type


```solidity
function recallUnvestedTokens() external;
```

## Events
### NewGoalAdded
Emitted when a new goal is added


```solidity
event NewGoalAdded(uint256 goalAmount, uint256 goalNumber);
```

### GoalReached
Emitted when a goal is reached


```solidity
event GoalReached(uint256 goalNumber);
```

### UnvestedTokensRecalled
Emitted when unvested tokens are recalled


```solidity
event UnvestedTokensRecalled(uint256 unvestedTokens);
```

## Errors
### InvalidGoalNumber
ERRORS                 ///

Thrown when an invalid goal number is provided


```solidity

```

### OnlyTeamVesting
Thrown when a function is called that's only applicable to TeamVesting


```solidity

```

### InvalidGoalArrayLength
Thrown when the goal array length is invalid


```solidity

```

### InvalidToken
Thrown when the token address is invalid


```solidity

```
